title: J-Pop
style: A quintessential 90s Japanese anime OP, this track blends J-pop with Japanese pop rock at around 100 BPM, driven by bright distorted guitars and upbeat drums. The passionate vocal melody and rhythm-packed, youthful chorus brim with hope and adventure, capturing the vibrant energy of classic Japanese animation.
